result.requirement: The system shall manage the full lifecycle of the Customer Profile, enabling the creation, modification, and archival of identity and preference records throughout the customer's engagement.
result.business_need: The business needs a centralized, accurate record of customer identity and preferences to ensure secure order routing, accurate financial settlement, and personalized service delivery.
functional_behaviour: The system shall allow authorized actors to create a new Customer Profile with unique identifiers and verified contact details.
The system shall enable authorized actors to update existing Customer Profile information, including address changes and preference updates.
The system shall archive Customer Profile data upon account closure or significant status changes while retaining historical records.
The system shall enforce data validation rules to ensure all stored identity and contact information meets regulatory and operational standards.
The system shall link the Customer Profile to associated Order Requests and Financial Transaction Records for a complete audit trail.
related_information_requirements: Unique customer identifiers and verified delivery addresses
Primary contact methods including phone and email
Customer preference history and special handling notes
Fraud risk indicators and transaction patterns
business_rules: A Customer Profile must contain a unique identifier before any Order Request can be associated with it.
Contact details within a Customer Profile must be verified before the profile status is set to active.
Archived Customer Profiles must retain all historical data and cannot be modified after the archival action is confirmed.
Any modification to a Customer Profile must be timestamped and attributed to the actor performing the change.

acceptance_criteria.given: An actor initiates the creation of a new customer account
acceptance_criteria.when: The actor enters valid unique identifiers and contact details
acceptance_criteria.then: The system creates a new Customer Profile with an active status and links it to the actor's session

acceptance_criteria.given: An actor attempts to modify a Customer Profile with invalid data
acceptance_criteria.when: The data fails validation rules for required fields or format
acceptance_criteria.then: The system rejects the update and displays a specific error message indicating the validation failure
